quotes: Three-level: project → config → version.

`V` opens one tree — **project → config → version** — built on the browser's existing
`fieldTree` widget (`browse_fieldtree.go:151`), replacing the `huh.Select` step chain used
today.

`↑`/`↓` move the cursor (`fieldTree.up`/`down`); `→`/`l` expand, `←`/`h` collapse
  (`fieldTree.setCollapsed`); `space` toggles (`fieldTree.toggle`).

`↑`/`↓` move the cursor (`fieldTree.up`/`down`); `→`/`l` expand, `←`/`h` collapse
  (`fieldTree.setCollapsed`); `space` toggles (`fieldTree.toggle`).
`enter` on a **version leaf** selects it and arms the confirm.

`enter` on a project or config
  branch only toggles it — a branch is never a selection.
`esc` cancels the picker with `statusDCCanceled`.
projects | picker opens | `ListBenchmarkProjects` (1 request)
configs of a project | that project is first expanded | `ListDeployConfigs(project)` + `latestPerConfig`
versions of a config | that config is first expanded | `fetchDeployConfigVersions(project, name)`

An unexpanded branch holds one placeholder child (`loading…`, replaced on arrival; `(none)` when
the listing is empty).

Each branch caches its children after first load; re-collapsing and
re-expanding does not refetch.
**Linked deployment:** auto-expand its project and its config, cursor on the current version.

**Unlinked deployment:** auto-expand the sole project when the org has exactly one (Q2),
  otherwise all projects stay collapsed, cursor on the first.

Type-to-filter in the picker: `fieldTree` has no equivalent of `huh.Select`'s
  `.Filtering(true)`, so the tree is cursor-navigated only in this change (follow-up).
Cross-project adoption falls out of the project level being a root of the tree.

`enter` on a version leaf arms `confirmState` with that leaf's project and config name (not the
   linked config's) — covers the cross-project case.

`completeDCSelection` populates `dcProject`/`dcName` from the chosen leaf instead
of from the linked config — no transport change needed for cross-config or cross-project
switching.
dcTree    *fieldTree                     // the picker; non-nil exactly while it is open

dcLinked  *schemasv1.DeployConfigSchema  // linked config, when any: drives auto-expand,
                                         // cursor placement, and is the merge baseline

dcLoading map[string]bool                // in-flight branch loads, keyed "" (projects) /
                                         // "<project>" / "<project>\x00<config>"

// dcForm, dcVersions, dcCurrent, dcChoice are REPLACED by the tree.
// dcVersLoading is replaced by len(dcLoading) > 0.
pick any // non-nil only on picker version leaves; nil on every node the existing trees build

The picker sets `pick` to the
`*schemasv1.DeployConfigSchema` on each version leaf; `enter` reads it back.
Zero value `nil` leaves the config/revision/diff trees unaffected.

Also add `current() *fieldNode` on `fieldTree`, returning the node under the cursor, so the
picker does not reach into the unexported `flat`/`cursor` internals.
type dcProjectsMsg struct { name string; items []*schemasv1.BenchmarkProjectSchema; err error }
type dcConfigsMsg  struct { name, project string; items []*schemasv1.DeployConfigSchema; err error }
type dcVersionsMsg struct { name, project, config string; items []*schemasv1.DeployConfigSchema; err error }

`name` is the deployment name on all three, preserving the existing stale-result drop
(`msg.name != m.sel.Name`).

`project`/`config` identify which branch the result fills, so a
result arriving after the user collapsed that branch lands on the right node rather than the
cursor's.

`currentOverlay()` (`browse_model.go:880`) keeps a single arm, `case m.dcTree != nil:` returning
`overlayHandler{m.updateDCPicker, m.dcPickerView}`.

`autoRefreshPaused()`: the `m.dcVersLoading` arm is replaced by `m.dcTree != nil`, so
auto-refresh cannot swap `m.sel` while the picker is open, including while idle between branch
loads (which the old in-flight flag did not cover).

`browse_model.go:1910-1917` drops the `DeployConfigID == nil` rejection — `V` is valid on any
detail-screen selection.

`helpAdapter.dcLinked` (`browse_model.go:2916`) loses its
`DeployConfigID != nil` condition so the key is advertised on unlinked deployments too.

Config node: `"<name>  (latest v<N>)"`, plus `"  (shared)"` when `Shared` is true, plus
  `"  (current)"` when it is the linked config.
├─ ▸ config-x   (latest v7)  (shared)
`(shared)` / `(current)` / `(latest)` markers; confirm copy per above.
├─ ▾ config-y   (latest v2)  (current)
│    ├─ v2  2026-07-01 09:14  bump engine image   (latest) (current)

Version leaf: `"v<N>  <created>  <description>"` (reusing the label
  `newDeployConfigVersionPicker` builds, `browse_source_config.go:361-362`, and its
  `trunc`/`sanitizeCell` helpers), plus `"  (latest)"` on the newest and `"  (current)"` on the
  deployment's current version.

A shared config's node label carries `(shared)`; the linked one carries `(current)`; the
   newest version leaf carries `(latest)`.
Panel label (`browse_panels.go:226-228`): `"V: switch version"` → `"V: switch deploy config"`.

**Rule:** when the linked baseline is absent, `preserveDeploymentDivergences` performs a
**two-way deep merge** instead of returning the target verbatim: target config is base,
deployment's current configuration is overlay, overlay wins on conflicting leaves, keys only the
target carries still land.

Implement the two-way merge as a distinct,
recursing map-level helper (the map twin of `mergeJSONPtr`), not as `threeWayMerge` with an empty
baseline.
Keep the three-way divergence merge against the previously-linked baseline; confirm copy states overrides are carried across.
switching redeploys the deployment (already true today);
the deployment's overrides are carried across (decision A/B);

when the chosen config is shared: its content is owned by the shared spec, so the next
  `mcloud deploy-config apply` creates a new version and the config's *latest* moves — the
  deployment stays pinned to the version selected here, since versions are immutable rows.
`V` reaches every deploy config in the project, shared included.

`preserveDeploymentDivergences` nil-baseline fix (Q3) — also fixes the same gap for
  `mcloud deployment deploy-config set`, which shares the function.

No API or
server change is required: `deployConfigService.List` with no name filter already returns the
latest version of every distinct config in the project, and `api.Client.ListDeployConfigs` is
already used elsewhere in the CLI.
Any API-server or schema change.
### Transport — unchanged

Converting `browse_source_config.go`'s source picker or `browse_form_sync.go`'s sync picker to
  the tree — they keep their `huh.Select` steps; only `V` changes.

Warning that editing a shared config gets reverted: moot, since the TUI/CLI has no deploy-config
  write path at all (reads only via `internal/mcloudcli/api/deploy_config.go`; the sole write is
  `mcloud deploy-config apply`, `deploy_config_cmd.go:86`).

Refactoring `browse_source_config.go` and the new `V` flow into one generic picker: they differ
  in presentation, terminal action (reseed a live form vs. arm a confirm + PATCH), and entry
  conditions.

Shared data helpers (`latestPerConfig`, `findDeployConfigVersion`,
  `fetchDeployConfigVersions`) are reused as-is.
